assets.name: straight
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished game asset: a square top-down dungeon STRAIGHT CORRIDOR tile illustration for a charming 1980s British fantasy wargame, Gary Chalk inspired pen-and-ink with hand-painted watercolor washes. Bold irregular dark umber ink outlines, chunky warm limestone flagstones, warm parchment and muted ochre, sparse olive moss, cozy slightly sinister old printed-board-game charm. Orthographic overhead view, not isometric. Centered straight corridor runs horizontally east to west, opening exactly at left and right midpoint, with a clear unobstructed center and roomy width about 45 percent of image height. Thick cutaway masonry masses above and below with big readable stone blocks and crosshatching, one tiny rusty drain in a corner, no creatures. Illustration fills the entire square, no exterior background, no margin, no border, no letters, no numbers, no arrows, no icons, no glow. The app will clip this square into an exact pointy-topped hexagon and overlay authoritative walls; prioritize richly painted stone texture and strong simple masses that read at 64 pixels. Flat diffuse lighting, no cast shadows outside the tile, no photographic or 3D-render look. Output a single square image.

Wall crosshatching and a little moss in the sealed upper-left corner. No round room and no extra branches.
